description: Source code for a Bluetooth Mesh On-Demand Private Proxy Server implementation, including message handling, state management, and configuration persistence.

methods.name: od_priv_proxy_store
methods.description: Stores or deletes the on-demand proxy state in persistent storage.

methods.name: proxy_status_rsp
methods.description: Sends the current proxy status response message.

methods.name: handle_proxy_get
methods.description: Handles incoming proxy get messages and responds with status.

methods.name: handle_proxy_set
methods.description: Handles incoming proxy set messages, updates state, and responds.

methods.name: od_priv_proxy_srv_init
methods.description: Initializes the On-Demand Private Proxy server model.

methods.name: od_priv_proxy_srv_reset
methods.description: Resets the proxy server state to default.

methods.name: od_priv_proxy_srv_settings_set
methods.description: Sets the proxy server configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: od_priv_proxy_srv_pending_store
methods.description: Stores the current state pending configuration.

methods.name: bt_mesh_od_priv_proxy_srv_store_schedule
methods.description: Schedules storage of the proxy server state.
